name: slack_get_dm_messages
description: Get DM messages with a specific Slack user. Finds the DM channel, reads history, and can filter to messages sent by a specific sender. Use for questions like 'what were my last messages to @someone?'

parameters.name: other_user_id
parameters.description: Slack user ID of the other person in the DM conversation.

parameters.name: --sender_user_id
parameters.description: Optional Slack user ID to filter results to a specific sender (e.g., your own user ID).

returns: JSON with ok, found (bool), other_user_id, channel, messages list, and message counts.
